finding: Can unexplained correction directions reveal a missing goal? In N10, adding residual structure improves hidden-goal log loss by 0.00276–0.06192 nats across twelve settings. Hidden-goal detection AUC is 0.643–0.988 where positives exist; soft support never empties. All 12,288 cases and full replay verify. This is a constructed-mechanism result with a supplied hidden-goal model, not general protection against model misspecification.
